flows.title: Breathe — Onboarding Intro
flows.description: Interactive breathing dot-field that opens the AI questionnaire. The red ball morphs through four health-need states — Weight, Muscle, Pregnancy, Gut — auto-progressing and tappable via the segmented control.

handoff.State input: ViewModel “Machine” · number “state”: 0 ball · 1 weight · 2 muscle · 3 pregnancy · 4 gut
handoff.Caption output: number “shown”: 0 hidden · 1–4 feature caption · 5 intro blurb
handoff.Layout: 402pt design width · animation stage 450×554pt, ball center at 39% of stage height · header pinned to safe-area top, actions pinned above home bar
handoff.Type: Urbane Rounded Medium/DemiBold · Proxima Nova Regular (files in this folder)
handoff.Brand rule: Ball dots are red #FF3848 on #ED1C24; icons+headlines resolve to white. Never recolor.
handoff.Nav buttons: X + CTA = liquid-glass-js Containers (WebGL refraction of a page snapshot; X circle r22, CTA pill r27; tintOpacity 0.14, blur 5, rim 0.05, edge 0.01 — all tunable in the playground sidebar). Adaptive contrast flips content dark over light backdrops. Supersedes the earlier CSS backdrop-filter recipe. Native SwiftUI equivalent = .glassEffect().
handoff.Playground: Desktop (standard shell): sidebar with description, health-need state selector (drives ViewModel Machine.state, synced with the in-phone segmented control), and live Liquid Glass dials (blur, saturation, fill, rim, depth) + Copy values; device frame with Dynamic Island, fixed 874pt canvas. Mobile: original fullscreen adaptive layout with safe-area handling.

flows.title: Rewards — Pull to Redeem
flows.description: Loyalty coupon redeem sheet with four Figma-exact member tiers. The perforation is punched holes: pull the stub and they pop one by one with an elastic recoil and a haptic tick (Android), each ejecting its punched-out disc, until the tab rips free with confetti and heals into the redeemed card with the promo code. Desktop opens the full playground; mobile is fullscreen.

handoff.Design source: Figma · Diet Station 4.0 · Rewards states (section 17137-76380; Gold frame 17137-75698)
handoff.Level themes: Sheet gradients — Bronze #D5BB9F→#C9A682 (to bottom) · Silver #E5E7EB→#D1D5DB (to bottom) · Gold #E4A70F→#FFBC2A (to top) · VIP #270F0F→#0F0E0D (to bottom)
handoff.Text colors: Gold/VIP: heading #F9F9F9, body white · Bronze: heading #0B0E12, secondary #5C3F21 · Silver: heading #0B0E12, secondary #7A7A7A
handoff.Badge pills: No visible ring (the Figma renders show the spec'd stroke blends into the fill): 24pt pill, per-tier 45/55 two-stop gradient, soft top bevel (inset 0 1.5 1 rgba(255,255,255,.35)) + the Figma drop-shadow stack. Text: Gold #C59300 · Bronze rgba(76,64,51,.42) · Silver rgba(82,82,91,.46) · VIP white.
handoff.Gesture: Pull stub right · travel = 96px·tanh(drag/90) elastic resistance · tears at 62px · below threshold springs back with overshoot wobble · haptic navigator.vibrate(25) where supported
handoff.Redeemed state: Stub flies off (420ms cubic-bezier(.3,.6,.4,1)) with confetti burst at the perforation; body expands 278→368pt (450ms spring) into check + promo code chip
handoff.Layout: 402pt design width · sheet 806pt, top radius 38 · vouchers 368×125 radius 24 · stub 90pt · perforation 110pt dashed 8/8
handoff.Type: Urbane Rounded Light/Medium/DemiBold · Proxima Nova Regular (files in this folder)
handoff.Nav buttons: Liquid Glass (iOS 26) close in CSS backdrop-filter; native SwiftUI equivalent = .glassEffect()
handoff.Coupon material: Exact Figma fill stack, correctly composited: per-level tint (gold rgba(240,168,60,.35)) inside the clipped card + the rgba(173,173,173,.12) plus-lighter layer as a SIBLING so it blends with the sheet gradient (inside a clipped/masked box it blends against nothing and washes white — key implementation detail). Optional backdrop frost 0-30px, default 0 = pure Figma.
handoff.Viewport behavior: Desktop (>500px, fine pointer): sidebar + framed device. Mobile: fullscreen fit, sidebar hidden.
handoff.Rip mechanic: Punched-hole perforation: 7 true cutout holes (r3, even-odd SVG alpha mask) straddling x=277 so each splits into half-moons as the tab moves. Tab peels by rotating around the topmost intact hole (0.26deg/px + 0.10px/px slide); holes pop top-down at staggered thresholds (30%..100% of tear point), each pop = ring burst + ejected disc + 1.6px card recoil + navigator.vibrate(8). Last pop rips the tab free (vibrate [14,40,22]); clip-path inset heals the card into the redeemed state. Popped holes persist across released pulls.
handoff.Playground: Desktop: sidebar playground (standard) — description, level selector, live modifiers (tear point 40-90px, stretch 60-140px, confetti 0-30, glass frost 0-0.4, blur 1-12) + Copy values; device frame with Dynamic Island. Mobile: fullscreen with floating level bar.
handoff.Nav glass: X button = liquid-glass-js Container (radius 20, tintOpacity 0.14, blur 5). Adaptive contrast: page-snapshot luminance behind the button > 0.5 flips icon/text dark (#0B0E12), else white — so Bronze/Silver themes get a dark X, Gold/VIP keep white.
handoff.Themes: Two themes x four tiers. Tiered: whole sheet takes the tier's Figma variant. Red (Figma 16842-87694): flat brand red #ED1C24 sheet, coupon tint rgba(237,28,36,.35) + rgba(173,173,173,.12) plus-lighter, voucher drop-shadow 0 0 12 rgba(56,64,74,.12), white text — only the loyalty badge pill reflects the tier. Toggle in the playground sidebar (desktop) or the Red chip (mobile).
handoff.Backdrop: Strip behind the sheet: #A6A6A6 on Gold and Red themes, #FFFFFF on Bronze/Silver/VIP (per the Figma frames).
handoff.Pull tab: Widened to 125pt (from Figma's 90pt) for comfortable thumb reach — Rashid 2026-09-03. Seam/perforation at x=243.
handoff.Coupon shadow: Soft theme-tinted OUTER box-shadow (0 6 16 -2, alpha color per theme: gold rgba(146,100,10,.42) · bronze rgba(118,88,58,.38) · silver rgba(92,100,112,.32) · VIP rgba(0,0,0,.55) · red rgba(112,6,10,.48)) on a transparent box — outer shadows are spec-clipped outside the border-box, so nothing paints under the translucent fills. Hole visibility comes from a hairline rgba(0,0,0,.20) inner-edge ring on each punched hole.
handoff.Type scale: Coupon headline reduced for breathing room next to the 125pt tab: big 26/34, mid 17/24, tail 16/24 (from 30/20/18).
